pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. An annual planner containing EXACTLY TWELVE small MONTH calendar panels arranged in THREE ROWS of FOUR columns. Each mini month has blank binding header and small gray empty day grid. ONE thick red outer outline surrounds the ENTIRE set of twelve months together; a red arrow points to the outer outline to indicate the WHOLE YEAR. No individual month or day highlighted. All twelve panels white with gray lines, fully visible and countable. No names, dates, letters, numerals, writing or labels. Generous margins. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
